flaws.name: Crippled
flaws.description: Confined to a wheelchair. Speed is your Strength. Instant to move or -2 on speed and all actions to move.

flaws.name: Cumbersome
flaws.description: Rather large. No change to size, Stamina cannot go above 3. Must shop in specialty stores for clothing

flaws.name: Deformity
flaws.description: -2 off social rolls when meeting new people due to disfiguring limbs/scars/blemish

flaws.name: Dwarf
flaws.description: Size is 4. XP awarded for notable social problems.

flaws.name: Hard of Hearing
flaws.description: -2 from all hearing perception rolls.

flaws.name: Lame
flaws.description: Speed factor is 2 due to flaw in legs (artificial, crippled, crutches etc)

flaws.name: Mute
flaws.description: Cannot speak.

flaws.name: One Arm
flaws.description: Double time to perform manual tasks. Attempts to do task quickly are at -3

flaws.name: One Eye
flaws.description: Ranged attack penalties double. 10-again not re-rolled in driving, 1's subtract.

flaws.name: Poor Sight
flaws.description: -2 to all sight perception tests.

flaws.name: Addiction
flaws.description: Addicted to a substance. 3 sessions without indulging means its beaten. Indulgence here does not count for Gluttony.

flaws.name: Amnesia
flaws.description: Memories from past trauma surface unexpectedly. Sporadically forgets allies and enemies from past.

flaws.name: Behavior Blind
flaws.description: Unable to figure peoples moods and emotions (although Empathy rolls can provide). Cannot detect sarcasm etc.

flaws.name: Cannibal
flaws.description: A preference rather than addiction to human flesh.

flaws.name: Coward
flaws.description: Hesitates at dangerous or awkward situations.

flaws.name: Forgetful
flaws.description: Doesn't forget everything, just small details that make things frustrating, such as names and short term goals.

flaws.name: Illiterate
flaws.description: Might recognize simple words, but has trouble with sentences or books.

flaws.name: Nightmares
flaws.description: Dreams with intensity higher than Res become nightmares, keeping the new Intensity. Alt: Roll Res+Com, failure indicates character does not regain point on nightly Willpower.

flaws.name: Racist/Sexist
flaws.description: Has a strong bias against or for a certain social group to the exclusion of others of the same type.

flaws.name: Aloof
flaws.description: Shy and distant in social situations. Dislikes being the center of attention.

flaws.name: Dishonorably Discharged
flaws.description: Can not purchase Allies, Contacts or Status related to Military services and gain effect of the Notoriety Flaw among ex-service members.

flaws.name: Embarrassing Secret
flaws.description: A secret in the past. XP awarded for keeping it secret at the expense of allies. (If gets out may exchange for Notoriety or other appropriate Flaw)

flaws.name: Fealty
flaws.description: The character has a master that makes decisions for her, effectively trading free will for XP.

flaws.name: Notoriety
flaws.description: Inverse of Fame. If recognized, is met with negative reactions from those that would know.

flaws.name: Speech Impediment
flaws.description: Must be role-played. If forgotten, Storyteller may warn condition is curing.

flaws.name: Untrustworthy
flaws.description: -2 to Persuasion, Socialize, or any Manipulation test.
